label: Header & Footer (contextual tab)
purpose: contextual ribbon tab of the 'Header & Footer Tools' family; exists only while: header/footer editing mode is active (cursor in header or footer). Groups: Header & Footer, Insert, Navigation, Options, Position, Close. Appeared on the 'header' probe.

children.label: Header
children.tooltip:
Headers help you to repeat content at the top of every page.

They're useful for showcasing information, like title, author, and page number.
children.state_notes: group 'Header & Footer'; keytip Alt, J H, H; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Footer
children.tooltip:
Footers help you repeat content at the bottom of every page.

They're useful for showcasing information, like title, author, and page number.
children.state_notes: group 'Header & Footer'; keytip Alt, J H, O; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Page Number
children.tooltip:
Number the pages in your document.

You can choose from a variety of pre-defined looks or select your own format.
children.state_notes: group 'Header & Footer'; keytip Alt, J H, N U; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Date & Time...
children.tooltip: Quickly add the current date or time.
children.state_notes: group 'Insert'; keytip Alt, J H, D; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Document Info
children.tooltip:
Quickly insert information about your document, such as author or file name.

For more options, explore document properties and fields.
children.state_notes: group 'Insert'; keytip Alt, J H, I; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Quick Parts
children.tooltip:
Insert preformatted text, auto-text, document properties, and fields anywhere in the document.

To reuse content in your document, select it and save it to the Quick Part Gallery.
children.state_notes: group 'Insert'; keytip Alt, J H, Q; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Pictures...
children.tooltip: Insert pictures from your computer or from other computers that you're connected to.
children.state_notes: group 'Insert'; keytip Alt, J H, P; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Online Pictures...
children.tooltip: Find and insert pictures from a variety of online sources.
children.state_notes: group 'Insert'; keytip Alt, J H, F; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Go to Header

icon.description: Go to Header control (see icon crop)

children.tooltip: Edit the header on this page.
children.state_notes: group 'Navigation'; keytip Alt, J H, E; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Go to Footer

icon.description: Go to Footer control (see icon crop)

children.tooltip: Edit the footer on this page.
children.state_notes: group 'Navigation'; keytip Alt, J H, G; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Previous
children.tooltip: Jump to the previous header or footer.
children.state_notes: group 'Navigation'; keytip Alt, J H, R; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Next
children.tooltip: Jump to the next header or footer.
children.state_notes: group 'Navigation'; keytip Alt, J H, X; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Link to Previous

icon.description: Link to Previous control (see icon crop)

children.tooltip:
Link to the previous section to continue using the same header or footer.

Turn this feature off to create a different header or footer for the current section.
children.state_notes: group 'Navigation'; keytip Alt, J H, K; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Different First Page

icon.description: Different First Page control (see icon crop)

children.tooltip: Give the first page a different header and footer from the rest of your document.
children.state_notes: group 'Options'; keytip Alt, J H, A; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Different Odd & Even Pages

icon.description: Different Odd & Even Pages control (see icon crop)

children.tooltip: Specify that odd-numbered pages should have a different header and footer from even-numbered pages.
children.state_notes: group 'Options'; keytip Alt, J H, V; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Show Document Text

icon.description: Show Document Text control (see icon crop)

children.tooltip:
Show the part of the document not in the header or footer.

Turn off this option if you only want to see content in the header and footer.
children.state_notes: group 'Options'; keytip Alt, J H, W; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: More
children.tooltip: Specify the distance from the top of the page to the top of the header.
children.state_notes: group 'Position'; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Less
children.tooltip: Specify the distance from the top of the page to the top of the header.
children.state_notes: group 'Position'; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: More
children.tooltip: Specify the distance from the bottom of the page to the bottom of the footer.
children.state_notes: group 'Position'; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Less
children.tooltip: Specify the distance from the bottom of the page to the bottom of the footer.
children.state_notes: group 'Position'; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Insert Alignment Tab

icon.description: Insert Alignment Tab control (see icon crop)

children.tooltip: Insert a tab stop to help align content within the header or footer.
children.state_notes: group 'Position'; keytip Alt, J H, M; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

children.label: Close Header and Footer

icon.description: Close Header and Footer control (see icon crop)

children.tooltip:
Close the Header and Footer Tools.

You can also double-click the document area to return to editing it.
children.state_notes: group 'Close'; keytip Alt, J H, C; face documented, not pressed (contextual surface layer)

trigger_condition: header/footer editing mode is active (cursor in header or footer)
